```{=html}
<p class="pm-filter" hidden>Posts filed under <span data-category></span>. <a href="blog.html">Show all posts</a></p>
<script>
  // Quarto filters the list when the address ends in #category=...; say so.
  (() => {
    const note = document.querySelector(".pm-filter");
    const show = () => {
      const match = location.hash.match(/category=([^&]*)/);
      note.hidden = !match;
      if (match) note.querySelector("[data-category]").textContent = decodeURIComponent(match[1]);
    };
    addEventListener("hashchange", show);
    show();
  })();
</script>
```
